Opportunity Highlights Free Registration: No registration fee required. Hands-on Lab Access: Participants will get access to practical cybersecurity labs and CTF challenges. Exciting Prizes: Attractive prizes for competition winners. Practical Learning: An opportunity to test and improve cybersecurity skills through real-world-inspired challenges. Team participation and inter-college or inter-specialization participation will be subject to the event organisers' guidelines. The competition schedule, round duration and access details will be communicated to registered participants. Rules and Regulations All activities must be performed only within the authorised CTF platform and provided lab environments. Participants must not attack, scan

raw.details:
MassX CTF 2026 – Capture The Flag Competition

MassX CTF 2026 is an exciting cybersecurity and Capture The Flag (CTF) competition designed to provide participants with hands-on experience in ethical hacking and practical cybersecurity challenges.

Opportunity Highlights

  • Free Registration: No registration fee required.
  • Hands-on Lab Access: Participants will get access to practical cybersecurity labs and CTF challenges.
  • Exciting Prizes: Attractive prizes for competition winners.
  • Practical Learning: An opportunity to test and improve cybersecurity skills through real-world-inspired challenges.
  • Skill Development: Explore different areas of cybersecurity, problem-solving and ethical hacking.

Guidelines

  1. Participation is open to interested students with an enthusiasm for cybersecurity and ethical hacking.
  2. Participants should complete the registration process before the announced deadline.
  3. Team participation and inter-college or inter-specialization participation will be subject to the event organisers' guidelines.
  4. Participants will solve cybersecurity challenges in the provided CTF environment.
  5. Challenge categories and the total number of problems will be announced by the organisers.
  6. The competition schedule, round duration and access details will be communicated to registered participants.

Rules and Regulations

  1. All activities must be performed only within the authorised CTF platform and provided lab environments.
  2. Participants must not attack, scan
